body:
![ISleep Banner](https://imgur.com/n7VHWbh.png) # **ISleep** ### *Sleep anywhere, anytime - Control explosions in all dimensions* [![Maintained by FruitForge Studios](https://img.shields.io/badge/Maintained%20by-FruitForge%20Studios-4da6ff?style=for-the-badge)](https://fruitforge.com/discord) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1332150488753246310?color=7289da&label=Discord&logo=discord&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://fruitforge.com/discord) [![BETA](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-BETA-yellow?style=for-the-badge)](https://fruitforge.com/discord)
--- ## **Why Choose ISleep?** ISleep is an innovative plugin that allows players to sleep in any dimension while maintaining control over explosions. Perfect for servers looking to enhance their players' experience with advanced bed mechanics and safety features.
### 📖 **[FULL DOCUMENTATION HERE](https://docs.fruitforge.com/)** 📖
## **✨ Core Features** ### **🛏️ Sleep Features** - **Multi-Dimensional Sleep** - Sleep in any dimension - **Safe Sleeping** - Control where players can sleep - **Time Control** - Configure sleep mechanics regardless of time - **Distance Settings** - Customize bed interaction distance - **Safety Controls** - Manage monster proximity requirements ### **💥 Explosion Management** - **Dimension Control** - Configure explosion behavior per dimension - **Safety System** - Protect players from unsafe sleeping conditions - **Custom Messages** - Fully customizable notifications - **Simple Controls** - Easy-to-use commands ## **📋 Commands & Permissions** ### **Commands:** ``` /sleepreload ➜ Reload the plugin configuration /leave ➜ Leave the bed if sleeping ``` ### **Permissions:** ``` isleep.admin ➜ Permission to reload the plugin ``` ## **📦 Requirements & Compatibility** ### **Dependencies:** - ProtocolLib **(Required)** - 5.3.0 for Minecraft 1.13 - 1.21.1, 5.4.0 for Minecraft 1.21.2 - 1.21.8 ### **Supported Versions:** - Minecraft 1.13 - 1.21.8 - Spigot, Paper, Purpur ## **⚠️ BETA Notice** > This plugin is currently in BETA. While fully functional, you may encounter minor issues. Please report any bugs on our Discord server. ## **⚙️ Configuration Example** ```yaml # Settings.yml configuration example SneakOnly: false IgnoreWhere: true IgnoreTime: true IgnoreSafety: false IgnoreDistance: true IgnoreOthers: true ExplodeOnUnsafe: false # Set spawn point in other dimensions (Use with caution!) SetSpawnInOtherDimensions: false ``` ---
